summary: Aeon Acquisition I Corp. (a SPAC) filed an 8-K reporting it issued an unsecured promissory note to its sponsor, Aeon Acquisition Partners I LLC, for up to $250,000 to fund costs related to its initial business combination. The note is non-interest bearing, payable upon consummation of the business combination, and can be drawn in increments. The board approved the transaction. This is a typical SPAC working capital facility to extend the search period or cover expenses before a deal closes. Watch for any subsequent announcement of a target business combination, as this bridge loan signals active deal pursuit.
